description: This spacious and fully furnished studio apartment in Bay Square, Business Bay, offers a stylish and convenient urban lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most connected business and residential districts. Bay Square is surrounded by supermarkets, restaurants, cafés, pharmacies, banks, retail outlets, and other everyday conveniences, while its mixed-use environment combines residential and commercial spaces with direct access to major roads and public transport connections. The property is approximately a 10-minute walk from Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, with Business Bay and Dubai Mall Metro stations accessible via nearby bus connections, while Dubai International Airport is around 15 minutes away and Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab are approximately 20 minutes away. Combining generous studio proportions, furnished interiors, a private balcony, excellent amenities, and a prime Business Bay location close to the canal and Downtown Dubai, this residence offers a practical and well-connected home for modern city living.
